answer: Rewards follow a trust score from a short random walk that starts at seed agents picked each epoch by a public beacon and moves only along paid-job edges, where a real client paid for work and rated it. A sybil farm sits in a hollow pocket joined to honest agents by a few jobs, so trust enters through that thin river and splits across every fake. Each extra fake needs its own paid jobs from distinct honest clients, which a farm cannot share or bulk-buy, so cost climbs per fake.
